source: General Directorate of Agriculture (GDA), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Cambodia — Sweet Corn Production Handbook (ផលិតកម្មដំណំពោតផ្អែម), in partnership with SNV
text:
Planting seasons for corn in Cambodia:

Rainy season (វស្សា): For riverside/floodplain soil areas, plant from late April to mid-May and harvest at the end of July. For red soil areas, plant from May to July and harvest at the end of September.

Dry season (ប្រាំង): Planting begins after the cold season, from around December to January, with harvest at the end of March to early April.

Seed and variety selection: Corn is an important crop in Cambodia's agriculture sector, grown for food (boiled, roasted, steamed) as well as animal feed. Popular corn varieties grown for young-ear eating in Cambodia include waxy/glutinous corn, white corn, and sweet corn, which command higher market prices. Corn varieties fall into three maturity classes: early varieties (55-60 days), medium varieties (75-85 days), and late varieties (over 90 days). To achieve high yield, farmers must carefully select seed. Good seed for planting should have these characteristics: free of pest and disease contamination; pure seed with high yield potential; well-dried seed; seed purity above 95%; germination rate above 85%; new seed, not stored for many months or years; and seed resistant to disease and pests, without insect damage or cracking.

Seed germination testing (ការបណ្តុះសាកល្បង): This is a technique to determine germination percentage before planting. To promote fast germination, seed should be soaked for 2-3 hours beforehand. Germination testing is important for farmers to calculate proper seeding density per hectare, and to avoid using seed with low germination rate or over-seeding per hole. If germination is poor, the seed should instead be used for food/consumption rather than planting. A common testing method: take 100 randomly selected seeds, arrange them on a plate or damp cloth, soak in water 3 times over 1 day, then store them in a safe, well-ventilated place for 2-3 days to observe the germination percentage. Good seed for planting should have a germination rate of 85% or higher.
